_about: Written by the Team Comeback HQ shipping run; the HQ autopilot applies these entries to the HQ backlog and run log. Commits to this file use [skip render].

items.note: A GitHub Action fills each new week from nflverse's free stats every Tue and Wed at 7:15 AM. Matched every hand-logged week exactly and backfilled Week 7 for 11 legs.
Closing odds were already captured on each scan; each leg now also records when its close was taken, and the dashboard shows CLV with leg count, minutes before start, and legs with no close.
Firms that trail SPY on all of the last 20 sessions get a 'Thesis review due' badge on the dashboard; it clears itself when they catch up. First possible flag mid-November (11 sessions so far).

3 of 62 Florida jobs now score 70+ (Ally fraud analyst, Fortegra claims analyst, Siemens shipping/receiving), up from 0. IT/cyber/drafting 'operations analyst' roles and 7+ year asks now drop below 40. Skipped the plan's SQL/Python/Tableau keywords since they aren't on the resume.

Month-end mode: in the last 4 days of a month each scan may spend about twice as much (about 31 credits now) and minor sports are always considered, so credits don't expire unused. The 25-credit floor still holds.
Black Swan is now exhibition: out of the racing pool, open positions run to their stops, no new entries, and its card says why. Bringing it back is a config change after a passed thesis review.
items.owner_action: Tell the HQ when Black Swan should rejoin the race after its thesis review.

items.note: Each slip card shows its chance to cash and each slip page shows the weakest leg and expected value. Today: Goat Whale and New Systems under 0.1%, Fun 0.6%; weakest leg DJ Moore at about 1%. Computed live, so it updates with each weekly auto-fill.

Full Throttle is retired (no new trades, no AI playbook call, history kept); Rapid Fire races on its own rules. Kept Rapid Fire's settings because the two results were within noise and Full Throttle's 3x ETFs would add risk.
The 212 graded games live only in the app's storage on your phone, not in the repo, so there's nothing to freeze or backtest yet.
